rules.description: 三项指标均只统计百亿补贴活动；不混入普通活动。

snippets.description: 单个指标在批准日期范围内求和。
snippets.template: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("{metric_field}"), 0) AS value FROM "{table}" WHERE "{date_field}" >= ? AND "{date_field}" <= ? AND "{condition_field}" = ?

snippets.description: 在批准日期范围内按行业分组求和。
snippets.template: SELECT "{group_field}" AS group_value, COALESCE(SUM("{metric_field}"), 0) AS value FROM "{table}" WHERE "{date_field}" >= ? AND "{date_field}" <= ? AND "{condition_field}" = ? GROUP BY "{group_field}" ORDER BY group_value
